fields.description:
SECONDARY cleanup (NOT the health-lane pack lever): a branch-wide sweep that removes eligible
`.retired` tombstone **blobs** + folded companions from full-history/working-tree packs, honoring
the S1 eligibility check and the S3 override invariant. Runs AFTER, and on top of, the S1
commit/tree-collapse baseline. Portable (operation/test-linked, not CI-specific). Independently
verifiable: only eligible tombstones removed; I1–I9 preserved on a reconvergence fixture.
degradable-appalling-cavy's retired-sidecar reclaim rides on this.

NOTE (re-scoped 2026-08-29): `.retired` files are BLOBS and the CI-guarded `verify-identity` pack
is BLOBLESS (zero blobs), so this sweep shrinks the guarded pack by ~0. It is retained only as
secondary sidecar-blob hygiene for full-history clones; the pack-shrink lever is the S1
commit/tree collapse. See epic comment 'Child-roster re-scope'.
